vision_probe.note: Toy probe proves the visual-reasoning task class (charts) is real and auto-gradeable — the class Kimi invested in early.

coding_probe.conclusion: Synthetic self-contained tests give clean 0/1 RL rewards; scraped repo tests are ~40% noisy — validating the paper's choice to generate tests.

interpretation: Vision (charts/geo/science-graphics) was a forward bet on agentic grounding beyond chat; coding RL needed generated tests because web tests are impure. Both hold up under lightweight replication.
paper_ref: Kimi k1.5 Sec.2-3 data recipe; Kimi-VL follow-ups
